# Test Fixture Attribution

## test_signal_1_nspec.csv

240-bin reference specific loudness N'(z) for ISO 532-1:2017 Annex B Signal 1
(free-field, 28 one-third-octave bands). Used to validate the spreading
function and integration at 0.1 Bark resolution.

Source: MoSQITo project, file
`validations/sq_metrics/loudness_zwst/input/ISO_532_1/test_signal_1.csv`
(<https://github.com/Eomys/MoSQITo>, Apache License 2.0).
